Bill Vinovich and his crew will be in Denver this Thursday for the AFC West matchup between the Raiders and Broncos. Clete Blakeman will be in Germany on Sunday morning for the Falcons-Colts game in Berlin.

Carl Cheffers, John Hussey, and Craig Wrolstad are off this week.

All times are Eastern. The 2025 officiating crews are listed here, but note that there may be substitutions from the regular crew personnel each week.
